notes.title: Official Release Date Postponed
notes.notes:
Development of VOSS Turbo is still underway, but the prior release date set for the end of March has been delayed. We are still working diligently on the project, and feel as though it will take another two month to meet our satisfaction. We hope to release VOSS Turbo by the end of May.
  Fingers, tendrils, tentacles, and whatever else crossed; we will have the project completed earlier so that we can get it into your hands, tentacles... or whatever. Once the project meets our satisfaction, we will deliver it to you. Thank you for you patience.

notes.title: JET THRUSTERS and DRIFTING have been added.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]All Cruiser models come standard with [b]Jet Thrusters.[/b] Tap, then hold the Utility button to increase forward speed. These boosters can stay operational for 5 seconds at a time while holding the Utility button. They are self charging, but need some time.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Space is one slippery mistress! The longer a direction is held, the more momentum your cruiser gains, and the longer the [b]Drifting[/b] will last. This can work to your advantage in some cases, but you better stay alert or else you might slide into a quasar!
[/list]

NEW ITEMS HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE SHOP
[list]
[*] [b]Drift Suppressor[/b] will lessen the effects of space Drifting. It'll give you a little more control... for a low low price of course.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Booster Upgrade[/b] will greatly increase the forward speed granted by the Jet Thrusters. 
[/list]

notes.title: The Flood Gates have been closed.
notes.notes: Dynamic Difficulty has been toggled off. In the game Settings, you can Toggle it back on for a nightmare of a time. Monsters from beaten stages will appear in new stages, increasing difficulty. The floodgates are wide open once Dynamic Difficulty is toggled on, bringing in enemies from all 30 stages. The full catalogue of monsters are unlocked in the Early Access version, but will be sealed away again on full release.

notes.title: Difficulty increased slightly, and some new content has been added.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Japanese Translation is available.
[*]Difficulty increased slightly.
[*]New Stage has been unlocked!
[/list]
  We've noticed that the save features have not been unlocked yet, and because of that the Dynamic Difficulty is not being utilized in this current version. Because we know that our player demographic are masochists and enjoy challenging themselves; we figured turning up the difficulty would be more entertaining for our players. 
  If you are looking for an easier time, you can set the Dynamic Difficulty to off in the settings menu in the Game Play options. 

  A new stage has been unlocked, can you find it? Here's a hint: Beyond the dry lands lies a contradictory line in the sand...

  Good luck finding it.

notes.title: Some fixes, Quality of Life changes, and added Content
notes.notes: We've added some text to make navigation easier, as well as added a couple of new stages. Here's a hint if you're out to find  some new zones: [u]Under the canopy, under the ground, is where a hot river will be[/u]. Here's a hint for another: [u]beyond a place that is really wet, you'll find a place that is really dry.[/u]
